'''Chaos druids''' are low-level [[human]]s commonly killed for their frequent drops of [[herb]]s. Unlike other druids, they worship [[Zamorak]]. They attack with their fists and make use of a spell that appears to be a combination of the [[Confuse]] and [[Bind]] spells, binding their target very briefly if successful.

Players who decide to kill chaos druids in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]] should beware of [[Player killing|player killers]] who disguise themselves in [[Zamorak monk robes|Zamorak robes]] to take on the appearance of a chaos druid. If you attack another player, you will become [[Skull (status)|skulled]] and potentially lose all of your items.
